capabilities: favorite plugins and themes directly from the plugin browser, community plugins tab, and theme browser
maintain global in-use and known lists of plugins and themes across vaults
manage favorites, in-use, and known lists through commands
export and import list backups as timestamped JSON files
disambiguation: Not a note-bookmarking tool; it manages favorites of plugins and themes, not notes.
extras: README carries a caution that the plugin is not expected to work since Obsidian v1.13.4 changed the settings UI and that nearly the full plugin code needs rework (see issue #24); several destructive commands permanently clear lists and cannot be undone.
problem: Obsidian's plugin and theme browsers are per-vault, so users have to re-search and re-find the same plugins and themes in every vault they open.
summary: Global favorites manager that lets you mark plugins and themes once and access the same lists from every vault on your device.
